basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old vape enthusiast hailing from Denver, Colorado. I work as a mechanical engineer, which feeds my curiosity in tech and gadgets. In my spare time, I love experimenting with different vaping setups and sharing my insights with the Reddit community. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. I dislike poorly designed products and misinformation, but I'm always up for a good laugh.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in vaping is largely self-taught, combined with my engineering background. I've spent years tinkering with various devices, learning from both successes and failures. This hands-on experience, coupled with active participation in vaping communities, has deepened my knowledge.
